# About ZAgent

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/unified/about-zagent
**Captured:** 2026-09-07 via rendered Zscaler Help article in browser.
**Capture form:** scoped paraphrase of availability, interaction, and session-history guidance.

## Availability and purpose

The article marks ZAgent as **Limited Availability** and directs customers to
Zscaler Support for enablement. It describes conversational assistance and
predefined agents for administrative configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting,
and optimization across the Zscaler SASE platform. It says ZAgent is included
with specified subscriptions without identifying every eligible subscription.

## Interaction and session history

The Admin Console's Wand icon opens the ZAgent drawer. An administrator can
create a chat, review history, enter a prompt, and select an agent and a skill.
The article describes `@` for agent selection and `/` for skill selection.
Responses may offer actions such as starting diagnostics or viewing device
details.

Prompts and responses are retained as session history for a rolling **14 days**.
The history view is empty when there have been no sessions in that period.

## Capture boundary

This article describes an Admin Console feature. It does not specify a public
API, MCP compatibility, agent permission scopes, or the complete subscription
entitlement list. Those surfaces were not verified by this capture.
